title: cachrys ferulacea
intro: Cachrys ferulacea, commonly known as Wild Fennel or Ferula, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean and the Middle East. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to provide relief from various health conditions such as fever, colds, and respiratory issues, making it a valuable natural remedy. The therapeutic actions of Cachrys ferulacea include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating coughs, sore throats, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, particularly ferulic acid and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
